criteria.notes: The three-level civic directory, multilingual search, highlight mode, and reviewed routing behavior match the generation brief.
The redraw preserves the functional floor evidence while intentionally using a clearer signage-oriented orthogonal plan.
The civic identity, room zoning, circulation, level controls, and destination detail view form a specific wayfinding product.
Department labels, room names, level controls, and route guidance remain legible at both Full HD and compact review sizes.
Default, custom light, selected-room, pulse, and route states retain sufficient contrast.
Measured SVG text fitting keeps every visible label within its authored room safe width and clear of stairs and elevators.
The map, directory, detail panel, keyboard, and compact layouts use the available surface without collisions or clipped controls.
Map geometry and controls are coherent across the default and custom theme palettes.
The plan-led spatial interface is materially distinct from dashboard and card-oriented examples.

screenshots.notes: Default Full HD composition is balanced, readable, and collision-free.
Compact composition preserves navigation, labels, and a usable scrolling directory.
Selected destination is clear without obscuring the room label or circulation.
Default scenario matches the accepted Full HD layout.
Compact scenario has no clipped labels, controls, or amenities.
Destination-level route leaves the elevator and terminates at the reviewed room entrance.
Origin-level guidance clearly directs the visitor to the central elevator.
Custom light theme remains coherent and readable across map and directory surfaces.
Empty state is explicit while the map remains useful and stable.
Large multilingual signage keyboard fits the compact surface without overlap.
Level 3 labels wrap within non-overlapping room zones and remain clear of amenities.
Level 2 labels and open-below circulation remain collision-free.
Live datasource replacement updates the directory without destabilizing the map.
Long directory remains scrollable with stable map allocation.
Long destination content wraps safely and retains the cross-floor action.
Long branding and heading content stays within the header composition.
Row-array datasource normalization produces the same stable directory layout.
Same-floor route uses straight orthogonal segments and ends at the room doorway.
Zoomed route remains registered to the plan with square caps and miter joins.
